props.name: items
props.description: Item objects in the collection.

props.name: children
props.type: number | boolean | Node | JSX.ArrayElement | (string & {}) | ((item: T) => JSX.Element)
props.description: The contents of the collection.

props.name: class
props.description: Additional CSS class name for the menu. Legacy alias.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the trigger button. Legacy alias.

props.name: isQuiet
props.description: Whether the button should be displayed with a quiet style.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the trigger is disabled.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the ActionButton.

props.name: menuSize
props.description: The size of the Menu.

props.name: hideLinkOutIcon
props.description: Hides the default link out icons on menu items that open links in a new tab.

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of the menu relative to the trigger.

props.name: direction
props.description: Where the Menu opens relative to its trigger.

props.name: shouldFlip
props.description: Whether the menu should automatically flip direction when space is limited.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the overlay is open by default.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Whether the overlay is open, controlled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Handler called when the overlay open state changes.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Whether the trigger should receive focus on render.

props.name: styles
props.description: Spectrum-defined generated classes for the trigger button.

props.name: UNSAFE_className
props.description: Additional CSS class name for the trigger button. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: UNSAFE_style
props.description: Additional inline styles for the trigger button. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: id
props.description: Identifies the trigger element.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for the trigger button.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Identifies the element that labels the trigger button.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Identifies the element that describes the trigger button.

props.name: aria-details
props.description: Identifies the element that provides details for the trigger button.

props.name: ref
props.type: HTMLButtonElement | ((el: HTMLButtonElement) => void) | { current?: HTMLButtonElement | null | undefined; }

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Handler called when focus moves out of the menu.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Handler called when the menu should close.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Handler called when focus moves into the menu.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Handler for selection changes.

props.name: render
props.description: Custom renderer for the menu element.

props.name: onFocusChange
props.description: Handler called when the focus state changes.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: The selection mode.

props.name: disallowEmptySelection
props.description: Whether empty selection is disallowed.

props.name: selectedKeys
props.description: Currently selected keys (controlled).

props.name: defaultSelectedKeys
props.description: Default selected keys (uncontrolled).

props.name: onAction
props.description: Handler called when an item is activated, with the activated item's value.

props.name: shouldCloseOnSelect
props.description: Whether the menu should close when an item is selected.

props.name: shouldFocusWrap
props.description: Whether focus should automatically wrap around.

props.name: disallowTypeAhead
props.description: Whether type-to-select is disabled.

props.name: selectionBehavior
props.description: How selection behaves on interaction.

props.name: allowDuplicateSelectionEvents
props.description: Whether to allow duplicate selection events.

props.name: getKey
props.description: Function to get the key from an item.

props.name: getTextValue
props.description: Function to get the text value from an item.

props.name: getDisabled
props.description: Function to check if an item is disabled.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: Keys of disabled items.

props.name: disabledBehavior
props.description: Whether disabled items can still receive focus.

props.name: staticChildren
props.description: Internal lazy static children accessor used when collection children need menu context.

props.name: renderEmptyState
props.description: Content to display when the menu has no items.

props.name: dragAndDropHooks
props.description: Drag and drop hooks from `useDragAndDrop`.
